blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Agriculture (DA) and the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) inked an accord to jointly develop P9.06 billion worth of farm-to-market road (FMR) projects across Luzon. The agreement between the two government agencies involves 605 FMR projects in 26 provinces, spanning the regions of Cordillera, Ilocos, Cagayan Valley, Central Luzon, and Calabarzon. READ: 2027 budget: P16B for farm-to-market roads insufficient – DA These FMR projects, which cover a total of 604 kilometers, will help improve connectivity between farms and markets.
